title: Stationary kinetic Krylov-Safonov estimates in space dimension one
body_text:
Stationary kinetic Krylov-Safonov estimates in space dimension one

We prove interior Hölder regularity for solutions of the stationary kinetic Fokker-Planck equation in non-divergence form in space dimension one. The estimate is independent of any small-oscillation condition on the diffusion coefficient.

Authors: Yuzhe Zhu
Categories: math.AP, math.AP
